Commentary.Commentary: So that is it from this game! The hosts, as expected have taken a 1-0 lead in this series. The second ODI now takes place on the 3rd of March and it starts at 1300 local (0700 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye!
Man of the Match, Liton Das, says he feels good. Sttaes the wicket was really good to bat on and he is enjoying his batting. Ends by saying Shanto and Rahim supported him well.

Mashrafe Mortaza says the last three four games have not been great in this format but today they were really good. States Liton Das was exceptional and he hopes he can carry on his form. Further adds Mithun and Mahmudullah also did well. Reckons they were good in all three departments and they are working hard and he hopes they continue to improve.

Chamu Chibhabha says the Bangladesh team played really well, Das was excellent and they managed to stitch partnerships on regular basis. States it is a nice venue for them and they are excited to play here and he hopes they can turn things around in the next game. Ends by saying Williams should be available for the next game but he can't say anything about Ervine.

Not a lot you can write about the Zimbabwe batting and bowling! None of their batters could score something significant. They were under par in both the departments which in the end, lead to their defeat.

A clinical performance from the hosts to record their biggest win in ODIs! To be honest it was set up by their batters, Liton Das, we should write. His score helped Bangladesh reach a massive total and their bowlers did their job brilliantly. Everybody except for Mahmuduallah had a wicket to their name. Rahman and Saifuddin were impressive at the front. Mortaza and Taijul did well after that. Hasan also chipped in with the wickets.

OUT! LBW! Excellent review from Bangladesh this time and Chakbva has to depart. Zimbabwe lose their second wicket and Saifuddin is up in joy. Good length delivery on off, Chakabva looks to sweep it fine down the leg side. He misses and the ball goes fine down the leg side to the fence. The Bangladesh players put in a huge appeal but the umpire turns it down. Saifuddin is convinced he has his man and he convinces Mortaza to review it. Replay rolls in and it shows that there is no inside edge. Ball Tracker then rolls in and it shows all red.
LBW appeal taken upstairs. Chakabva is the man in question. Let's see what the replays have to say.

Replays roll in and it shows that there is a big inside edge. The on-field decision is overturned and Chibhabha survives.
